instruction: Update the font size of the page 2 title to 32 points.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: This task requires changing the font size of the title 'Product Comparison' on slide 2 to 32 points. The expected_size is 406400 EMUs (English Metric Units), which equals 32pt (32 * 12700 = 406400). The evaluator checks if all runs in the title have this font size. Verified by understanding PowerPoint EMU conversion.

llm_judge_reasons: COMPLETE VERIFICATION: The metric correctly iterates through ALL paragraphs and ALL runs in the title text_frame (lines 37-48), checking each non-empty run's font size against the expected value. This ensures the entire title text is verified, not just a portion.

CORRECT LOGIC FLOW: The function uses appropriate early returns - it returns 0.0 immediately if ANY run doesn't match the expected size (line 48), and only returns 1.0 after successfully checking all runs (line 52). This is semantically correct for an all-or-nothing verification.

PROPER EDGE CASE HANDLING: The code correctly handles None font sizes (lines 43-45) by returning 0.0, which is appropriate since None means the font is using default/inherited size, not explicitly set to 32pt as required by the instruction.
CORRECT EXPECTED VALUE: The expected_size of 406400 EMUs correctly represents 32pt (32 × 12700 = 406400), matching the instruction requirement. The metadata explanation confirms this calculation.
APPROPRIATE POSTCONFIG: The postconfig activates the LibreOffice window and saves the file with Ctrl+S, ensuring the file state is fresh before verification.
CORRECT GETTER IMPLEMENTATION: The getter function properly downloads the file from VM using env.controller.get_file() and saves it to a temporary location for the metric to read.
SEMANTIC COVERAGE: All requirements in the instruction are verified - slide 2 (index 1), title text 'Product Comparison', and font size 32pt for ALL text in the title.
